externalBlockers.blocker: assigned focused verifier could not run
externalBlockers.error: RCAP factory plan failed: KY has an incomplete legal-review materialization.
externalBlockers.cause: scripts/lib/rcap-factory/normalization-readiness.mjs adoptLegalReviewMaterializationReceipts throws when exactly one of the KY receipt and the KY materialized review exists. tmp/rcap-factory/legal-review-materialization-receipts/KY.json is tracked and therefore present in every checkout, while tmp/rcap-factory/materialized-authority/legal-reviews/KY/KY__LEGAL-REVIEW__STATEWIDE__kentucky-record-clearing-legal-review__ASOF-2026-08-02__EN.md is materialized from the external Master Library archive and is absent. RCAP_AUTHORITY_ARCHIVE_PATH, RCAP_SOURCE_MATERIALIZATION_ROOT and RCAP_MASTER_LIBRARY_PATH are all unset in this environment, so buildFactoryPlan cannot complete and every --check-job invocation fails.
externalBlockers.contractStatus: legal-review-materialization-contract.json records KY as blocked_external_archive_and_verified_receipt_required, owned by SESSION_B under job rcap-ky-legal-review-materialization.
externalBlockers.note: Not bypassed. The blocker is reported rather than worked around: the tracked KY receipt was not removed and no review file was reconstructed. It blocks the plan-dependent verifier and owned-path check only; packet regeneration, hash and page-count reconciliation and page inspection are independent of it and were completed in full.

regeneration.note: Packets were regenerated by running the committed verifier unmodified against the baseline checkout; the assembled bytes were captured for page inspection without altering any implementation module.

structuralChecks.method: Per-page word bounding boxes from pdftotext -bbox over every page, plus per-page ink fraction over every rendered PNG at 100 dpi.
